title: Provocation in the dark triggers an encounter: combat starts and is narrated

Goblin.personality_traits: Cowardly but vicious in a pack
Goblin.combat_style: Hits and runs; flees when outnumbered

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I shout out into the darkness: show yourselves!

actions.text: The darkness answers. Goblins pour from the niches, rusty blades drawn, shrieking for blood!
